translations.web: and look to the earth, and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
translations.bsb: Then they will look to the earth and see only distress and darkness and the gloom of anguish. And they will be driven into utter darkness.
translations.kjv: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
translations.asv: and they shall look unto the earth, and behold, distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish; and into thick darkness they shall be driven away.
